test_name: Welch t-test: UK vs International AOV
null_hypothesis: Mean AOV is equal between UK and international customers.
alternative_hypothesis: Mean AOV differs between UK and international customers.
business_interpretation: At alpha=0.05, reject H0. UK mean AOV=358.97; international mean AOV=650.74.

null_hypothesis: Customer segment and churn status are independent.
alternative_hypothesis: Customer segment and churn status are associated.
business_interpretation: At alpha=0.05, reject H0; segment and churn status show an association.

null_hypothesis: All segment mean AOVs are equal.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one segment mean AOV differs.
